name: Modal
summary: A dialog centered over a dimmed page, built on native <dialog>.showModal() — which hands you the top layer, the backdrop, inertness, Tab kept inside and focus returned, and leaves you four things it does not do.
demoNote: Open example 1 and Tab past the last button: focus comes back around, because the browser does that for a dialog opened with showModal(). Example 3 lands focus on the safe answer, never on Delete — Enter is the key people press to make a dialog go away.

contract.useWhen: A native dialog over the page, and the ARIA you must not add to it.
keyboard: closes through the cancel event, so unsaved work can intercept it
cycles inside — showModal() makes the rest of the page inert
failureModes: aria-modal=true added by hand, which has made VoiceOver skip the dialog's own content
showModal() with no scroll lock — and overflow:hidden alone jumps the layout sideways
aria-expanded on the trigger, reporting on a thing the person is now inside
the outcome announced from a region inside the dialog, removed from the tree before it speaks
no visible close control, which is a trap on touch
a drag that starts inside and ends on the backdrop, closing the dialog
api: AC.createModal(root, options) -> { open, close, isOpen, triggers, element, destroy }
